title: The quantifier is every positive eta and the source problem remains undecided
statement: For ANY homogeneous Hessian-ROC quartic H on three-dimensional Sym(2),set H_eta=H+eta|S|^4 for EVERY eta>0,choose explicit C_eta,nu=1 and mu_eta at least C_eta(C_eta+2C_eta^2/(4eta))/6 and max(256B2^2,1024Bz^2),using c=eta/4 in B2,B4. Then EVERY P_eta globally ROC and H Hessian-QC IFF P_eta globally QC for EVERY eta>0,equivalently every positive rational eta. Forward direction uses strong norm-quartic perturbation and actual Hodge receiving; reverse restricts QC tests to symmetric actual gradients,scales epsilon to remove degree6,then eta->0. A strict actual source violation persists for sufficiently small eta and transfers for each finite-mu extension by explicit scaling. Whole 15-dimensional integrand cone is characterized via 3x3 binary-quartic Hessian and 9x9 PSD matrix-SOS,not angular catalogue,but compatible-field search remains separate. This does not decide source QC,give separation,or reduce EVERY unrestricted 2x2ROC problem back to Hessian quartics. Producer-identified prior art during a NEW ACTIVE continuation:Dal Maso,Fonseca,Leoni and Morini,2003,Higher order quasiconvexity reduces to quasiconvexity,arXiv math/0305138. At the supplied primary abstract statement scope,smooth strictly2-quasiconvex functions with p-growth,p>1,extend from symmetric matrices to classical quasiconvex functions with the SAME growth. The parent says it will use this degree-preserving result as a known tool. This is not independent priority adjudication or a new completed coupled result. It does NOT identify this explicit sextic polynomial,its constants,an ROC-only premise,the all-eta equivalence,or the uncorrected general-U density with that published theorem. Application retains the actual strictness,smoothness and growth hypotheses;no compatible transfer is asserted merely from the shared extension topic.
